entities.name: Our Lady of the Incarnation Cathedral, San Miguel de Tucumán
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Our Lady of the Incarnation Cathedral, also called San Miguel de Tucumán Cathedral, is the mother church of the city of San Miguel de Tucuman, in the province of Tucuman, in the South American country of Argentina. The temple was founded in the seventeenth century and is home to the metropolitan Archdiocese of Tucumán since 1897.
